name: Villanueva del Rey (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villanueva del Rey (a shield on blue, a horse and a tree).
history: Municipal flag of Villanueva del Rey; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villanueva del Rey arms — shield, horse and tree
